en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a long brick fire station with arched upper windows. In front of the building are multiple horse-drawn fire engines lined up with uniformed firefighters standing and sitting on the wagons. Trees partially frame the street scene on the left. The caption in red print at the bottom left reads "Göteborg," and on the right "Brandkåren rycker ut." A small code "D. No. 315" appears at the bottom, along with "Vk:2000:208" in black.
